I had an absolutely incredible experience with Dr. Pong and the Thailand Hair Transplant Center (THTC). After years of contemplating a hair transplant, I finally decided to take the plunge three years ago. Dr. Pong, with his friendly demeanor and extensive knowledge, guided me towards the best option for my situation, recommending FUT.

The procedure itself was nothing short of remarkable. Despite the anticipation of pain, it was nearly painless. The THTC team was exceptionally warm and attentive throughout the entire process. In fact, I was even treated to a foot massage during the injections, making me feel completely relaxed and cared for.

My initial plan for the transplant involved a specific hairline and outcome that, upon further examination, would have required an excessive number of grafts and potentially looked unnatural. Dr. Pong's honesty and professionalism shone through as he suggested an alternative approach. He advised me to return in a year if I still wanted to make adjustments. Without hesitation, I followed his advice, and a year later, I underwent a second procedure, once again receiving over 4000 grafts.

The results from both procedures have been nothing short of perfect. I've visited numerous hair stylists who were unaware of my hair transplant, and they couldn't tell the difference. Additionally, any concerns about scarring have been completely alleviated, as the scar from the procedure is now invisible.

I wholeheartedly endorse Dr. Pong and his exceptional team at THTC. This experience has been life-changing, and I am incredibly grateful for their expertise and care. If you're considering a hair transplant, look no further—Dr. Pong and THTC are the best in the business.

I give my thanks to the doctor and team.
I did a lot of research on hair transplant clinics and sent messages asking about each clinic and received different responses.
But when I examined the data of each clinic, it turned out that some information did not match and was not suitable for my condition, until one day I discovered this clinic. Thus, I decided to send a message to the doctor. It started with me sending photos to the doctor for evaluation. It turned out that I received a piece of very pleasant advice from the doctor.
After talking on the phone and was impressed by the doctor. I could understand that the doctor was considered a person with very good medical ethics. He gives advice directly to his customers without any expectation of benefit. Does not matter if the customers will use the service or not, he gives advice anyway. After deciding and studying for a long time, I decided to have a hair transplant at the doctor's clinic. And I was well advised about booking a car and accommodation.
From the day of the hair transplant to the day I returned, both the doctor and the team left a great impression on me along with my son. Furthermore, after the completion of the hair transplant, the doctor still did not let the patient down. The doctors often come and ask how the patient is doing.

To date, it has already been 5 months since the hair transplant. And this is something unbelievable. Today I texted the doctor to greet him. The doctor replied that today is the day when the patient has had 5 months of hair transplant. This is the doctor's kindness and care, which is not found in other clinics. After 5 months of hair transplantation, the results are satisfactory.
It is as if I have received a new life. I have more self-confidence.
Good price, and excellent aftercare. ❤️💟

First I went to consult another clinic where I was immediately attacked by a marketing team of 5 ladies that tried to push me into taking an offer that would expire two days later 😂
The next day I went to Dr Pongs clinic instead and here I was met by a very professional, knowledgeable and kind doctor and team.
At first I was a little nervous about the FUT surgery; would it be painful and how big would the scar be in the back of my head?
The operation itself was almost 100% pain free and now 7 month later I can't see a scar at all and the result is amazing. I highly recommend Dr Pong and his team.
